title: Minimal Controller Reset Ablation

cases.rationale: first long wait segment, hands full
explicit oak task newly in STM, hands full
redisclosed task evicted; new enemy arrives
post-death state, both hands hold cloth
after longest wait; task reminder current
late task reminder with 30 actions remaining

user_confirmed_sample_scope: 10 checkpoints of one parent trajectory, not ten independent failures
user_confirmed_prompt_scope: Preserve original model input pipeline and memory; release old-goal authority only in action arbitration
origin: Reuse exactly the original recorded suffix; no new baseline model sampling

normal_reset.stagnation: registered goal generation and string unchanged for 12 observed transitions; not hidden quest-state detection
normal_reset.consecutive_failures: three failed attempts of the same goal verb/target
normal_reset.feedback_disagreement: current public location satisfies enter target and current explicit public statement does not repeat it, or explicit public goal differs
normal_reset.counter_warmup: Only age/failure counters reconstructed from original prefix; no retroactive completed-location trigger
normal_reset.latch: Release this (generation,target) until original public-goal update changes identity

oracle_reset: Release current old-goal authority immediately at each selected checkpoint; a33/a35 primary anchors, other eight are late same-state diagnostic releases, no rewinding to a33
intervention: Only original unresolved-default arbitration may return existing non-REJECT LLM proposal; all original checks/bounds/transactions/syntax persist; do not clear target field or modify facts/render/STM
paired_response_reuse: Within a checkpoint, identical environment-state hash, step and exact messages reuse the same sampled response; exact old-state/input requests use Stage22 response; new calls only after divergence; never share across different checkpoint cases
stopping: Original native done or absolute action300; no early stopping for bad score or repeated wait; no failed-run resampling
hidden_state_access: Only reset-independent runner/replay, cache identity, evaluation and logging; detector receives only original public observations and controller goal/counters
interpretation: This is conditional ablation of arbitration authority, not deletion of all stale input, full controller bypass, ten independent episodes, or a mathematical oracle performance bound
outcomes: reset timing and first information/progress after reset
meaningful_recovery_rule: At least 5/10 checkpoints gain >=1 main quest reward OR at least one checkpoint completes chapter1; descriptive preregistered threshold, no significance claim
decision_rule: Reset does not meet rule and Oracle does: CONTROLLER_LIMIT_CONFIRMED
Neither meets rule: DESIGN_LIMIT_CONFIRMED, restricted to this ablation and budgets; do not infer absence of all planning ability
incomplete_runs: Do not classify pending or infrastructure-aborted runs as completed failures; all 30 trace slots must be accounted for
budget: No $20 limit; inherited $100/$25 anomaly guards, not spending targets; bounded at most3538 new model decisions before exact-response reuse

price_verification.peak_hours_utc: 01-04 and 06-10 Monday-Friday excluding Chinese public holidays
price_verification.cost_scope: Usage-based listed-rate cost; no provider account invoice access
